# Europe centrale (Dubois & Kergomard, 1914)

Marcel Dubois & J.-G. Kergomard, *Europe centrale. Extrait de la carte générale d'Europe*,
Augustin Challamel, Paris, 1914. 1:3,000,000. Borders are pre-war (Alsace-Lorraine German).

- Source: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Gallica, ark:/12148/btv1b53258198r
  (https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b53258198r), IIIF full-size download. Public domain.
- `europe-centrale-1914.jpg`: 12632 × 8860 px, sha256 a99ecedc8df9f09f1f0a8487ee68b8b2572800917587cdb1822f403b59038f03.

Georeferencing (control points, fitted model, place positions) lives in
`data/maps/dubois-kergomard-1914.json`; see `pipeline/georef.py`.
